trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

action.name: Ocean Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. {@hom}The spear magically returns to the merfolk's hand immediately after a ranged attack.
